description: Fleet view of Gooxi BMCs scraped by gooxi-exporter: reachability, chassis power, uptime, and sensor readings.

spec.description: Number of BMCs whose last scrape succeeded (sum of gooxi_up).
spec.title: BMCs Online

spec.description: Last scrape result per BMC: 1 = OK, 0 = login/API failure. Dips to 0 are outages or flapping sessions.
spec.title: BMC Reachability

spec.description: Wall time of one full BMC scrape per host. Sustained growth points at a slow BMC or network path.
spec.title: Scrape Duration

spec.description: Chassis power per BMC over time (1 = on, 0 = off). Unplanned drops to 0 are power events.
spec.title: Chassis Power State

spec.description: BMC POH counter — total cumulative time powered on since factory shipment, NOT uptime since last reboot.
spec.title: Power-On Hours (Lifetime)

spec.description: BMCs whose last scrape failed (login error, timeout, unreachable).
spec.title: BMCs Offline

spec.description: All temperature sensors (CPU, memory, motherboard, inlet) in degrees Celsius.
spec.title: Temperature

spec.description: Rail voltages reported by the BMC. Drift outside the rail window shows up here first.
spec.title: Voltage

spec.description: Cooling fan speeds. 0 = stopped/absent fan.
spec.title: Fan Speed

spec.description: PSU input power (PIN) in watts. Only sensors with unit=watts are shown; status registers excluded.
spec.title: Power Supply

spec.description: Current draw reported by the BMC in amperes.
spec.title: Current

spec.description: Processor utilization and related CPU sensors reported by the BMC.
spec.title: Processor

spec.description: Cooling device sensors (non-fan) reported by the BMC.
spec.title: Cooling Device

spec.description: Physical security intrusion sensors (e.g. chassis intrusion flag). 0 = secure, 1 = intrusion event.
spec.title: Physical Security

spec.description: Fan speeds over time. Watch for ramps as thermal load changes and for a fan pinned at max.
spec.title: Fan Speed (Trend)

spec.description: PSU input power (PIN) over time in watts. Tracks electrical draw as the load changes.
spec.title: Power Consumption (Trend)

spec.description: Number of BMCs reporting chassis power on.
spec.title: Chassis Power On

spec.description: Sensors with sensor_state > 1 (2 = warning, 3 = critical). Only alerting series are shown.
spec.title: Non-Normal Sensors

spec.description: Max sensor state per BMC: 1 = all normal, 2 = has warnings, 3 = has criticals.
spec.title: Worst Sensor State per Host

spec.description: Sensors currently in warning state (sensor_state = 2).
spec.title: Sensor Warnings

spec.description: Sensors currently in critical state (sensor_state = 3).
spec.title: Sensor Critical

spec.description: Average time the exporter spends on one BMC scrape (login + API calls + logout).
spec.title: Avg Scrape Duration

title: Gooxi BMC
